9	/-!
10	# Zariski gluing kit for locally certified classes (DD-2 stage S5b)
11	
12	The bricks of the S5b gluing keystone (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2):
13	
14	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_pullback`
15	  — regularity of the two-stage pulled equations from regularity of the composite
16	  pullback (the Kit's composite germ collapse, member-normalized).
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.span_range_num_mul_eq_top` — **the composite-cover span**: for a
18	  span-⊤ family `g` with away carriers `S i` and span-⊤ families `h i` on each `S i`
19	  with numerators `a i l` (`algebraMap R (S i) (a i l)` associated to `h i l`), the
20	  products `a i l * g i` span `⊤` in `R` — by prime avoidance: a prime missing some
21	  `g i` lifts to `Spec (S i)`, misses some `h i l` there, hence misses the numerator.
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isScalarTower_away` / `isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower` —
23	  tower-coherence helpers: maps out of a localization agree once they agree on the
24	  base (`IsLocalization.ringHom_ext`), and `k`-towers follow from `R`-towers.
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_certified_away_compat` — **the
26	  certified-input gluing core**: compatible CERTIFIED families over an away cover of
27	  `R` glue to a LOCALLY certified class over `R` restricting to them. The divisor
28	  assembly is the landed `awayGluedEquations`; local certifiability of the glue is
29	  witnessed by `mapAlg` of the input families along the identification of each
30	  carrier with `Localization.Away (r κ)` (`IsLocalization.algEquiv`), divisor-equal
31	  to the pulled glue by witness transport at the landed chart restriction
32	  `divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations`.
33	
34	The pinned keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` is
35	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarGlue`.
36	-/

59	/-- **Two-stage pulled-equation regularity from composite regularity**: if the pulled
60	equations along the composite `h = g ≫ f` have nonzerodivisor germs, so do the pulled
61	equations of the two-stage pullback — their own-member germs agree
62	(`germ_pullbackEqn_comp`), and own-member regularity spreads
63	(`germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_self`). -/
64	theorem germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_pullback {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
65	    {f : Y ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {h : Z ⟶ X} (hgf : g ≫ f = h) (E : X.LocalEquations)
66	    (hregf)
67	    (hregh : ∀ (y z : Z) (hz : z ∈ (E.cover.pullback h).opens y),
68	      (Z.presheaf.germ ((E.cover.pullback h).opens y) z hz).hom (pullbackEqn h E y)
69	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.presheaf.stalk z)) :
70	    ∀ (y z : Z) (hz : z ∈ ((E.pullback f hregf).cover.pullback g).opens y),
71	      (Z.presheaf.germ (((E.pullback f hregf).cover.pullback g).opens y) z hz).hom
72	          (pullbackEqn g (E.pullback f hregf) y)
73	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
74	  germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_self g (E.pullback f hregf) fun ζ =>
75	    germ_pullbackEqn_comp hgf E hregf ζ ▸
76	      hregh ζ ζ ((E.cover.pullback h).mem_opens ζ)

80	/-! ## Tower-coherence helpers -/
81	
82	/-- **Tower coherence over a localization**: a scalar tower `A → B → D` commutes as
83	soon as the three `R₀`-towers do, when `A` is a localization of `R₀` — two algebra
84	maps out of `A` agree once they agree on `R₀` (`IsLocalization.ringHom_ext`). -/
85	theorem isScalarTower_away {R₀ A B D : Type u} [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
86	    [CommRing D] [Algebra R₀ A] [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra R₀ D] [Algebra A B]
87	    [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D] (M : Submonoid R₀) [IsLocalization M A]
88	    [IsScalarTower R₀ A B] [IsScalarTower R₀ B D] [IsScalarTower R₀ A D] :
89	    IsScalarTower A B D :=
90	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (IsLocalization.ringHom_ext M (by
91	    rw [RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ A B,
92	      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ B D, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ A D]))
93	
94	/-- **Base-field tower coherence**: a scalar tower `k₀ → B → D` commutes as soon as
95	the two `k₀ → R₀`-factored towers and the `R₀`-tower do. -/
96	theorem isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower {k₀ R₀ B D : Type u} [CommRing k₀]
97	    [CommRing R₀] [CommRing B] [CommRing D] [Algebra k₀ R₀] [Algebra k₀ B]
98	    [Algebra k₀ D] [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra R₀ D] [Algebra B D]
99	    [IsScalarTower k₀ R₀ B] [IsScalarTower k₀ R₀ D] [IsScalarTower R₀ B D] :
100	    IsScalarTower k₀ B D :=
101	  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
102	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k₀ R₀ D, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ B D,
103	      RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k₀ R₀ B])
104	
105	/-! ## The composite-cover span -/
106	
107	/-- **The composite-cover span** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): for a span-⊤
108	family `g : ι → R` with away carriers `S i`, span-⊤ families `h i` on the `S i`, and
109	numerators `a i l` of the `h i l` (their images associated to the `h i l`), the
110	products `a i l * g i` span the unit ideal of `R`. Prime avoidance: a prime `M`
111	missing some `g i` is the trace of a prime `Q` of `S i`
112	(`PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range`); `Q` misses some `h i l`, hence `M`
113	misses the numerator `a i l`, hence the product. -/
114	theorem span_range_num_mul_eq_top {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u} (g : ι → R)
115	    (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
116	    [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
117	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
118	    {m : ι → ℕ} (h : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → S i)
119	    (hspan : ∀ i, Ideal.span (Set.range (h i)) = ⊤)
120	    (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → R)
121	    (hassoc : ∀ i l, Associated (algebraMap R (S i) (a i l)) (h i l)) :
122	    Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : Σ i, Fin (m i) => a p.1 p.2 * g p.1) = ⊤ := by
123	  by_contra hne
124	  obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
125	  haveI hMprime : M.IsPrime := hMmax.isPrime
126	  -- some `g i` avoids `M`
127	  obtain ⟨i, hgi⟩ : ∃ i, g i ∉ M := by
128	    by_contra hall
129	    push Not at hall
130	    have hM : Ideal.span (Set.range g) ≤ M := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
131	      rintro - ⟨i, rfl⟩
132	      exact hall i)
133	    rw [hg] at hM
134	    exact hMmax.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hM)
135	  -- `M` is the trace of a prime `Q` of `S i`
136	  have hmem : (⟨M, hMprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)
137	      ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (S i))) := by
138	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := S i) (g i)]
139	    exact hgi
140	  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmem
141	  have hQM : Q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (S i)) = M :=
142	    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hQ
143	  -- some `h i l` avoids `Q`
144	  obtain ⟨l, hhl⟩ : ∃ l, h i l ∉ Q.asIdeal := by
145	    by_contra hall
146	    push Not at hall
147	    have hQ' : Ideal.span (Set.range (h i)) ≤ Q.asIdeal := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
148	      rintro - ⟨l, rfl⟩
149	      exact hall l)
150	    rw [hspan i] at hQ'
151	    exact Q.isPrime.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hQ')
152	  -- the numerator avoids `M`
153	  have hal : a i l ∉ M := by
154	    intro hmem'
155	    have h1 : algebraMap R (S i) (a i l) ∈ Q.asIdeal :=
156	      Ideal.mem_comap.mp (hQM.symm ▸ hmem')
157	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hassoc i l
158	    exact hhl (hu ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_right (u : S i) Q.asIdeal h1)
159	  -- primality contradiction on the product
160	  have hmemM : a i l * g i ∈ M := hle (Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨i, l⟩, rfl⟩)
161	  rcases hMprime.mem_or_mem hmemM with hc | hc
162	  · exact hal hc
163	  · exact hgi hc

169	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
170	
171	/-- **The certified-input gluing core** (S5b): a family of CERTIFIED divisor families
172	over a finite away cover of `R`, compatible on the overlap carriers, glues to a
173	LOCALLY certified class over `R` restricting to the given classes. The divisor
174	assembly is the landed `awayGluedEquations`; the glue is locally certified over the
175	same cover — each certified family transports along the identification of its carrier
176	with `Localization.Away (r κ)` (`IsLocalization.algEquiv`) and stays divisor-equal to
177	the pulled glue by witness transport at the landed chart restriction. -/
178	theorem DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_certified_away_compat
179	    {κ : Type u} [Finite κ] (r : κ → R) (S' : κ → Type u)
180	    [∀ q, CommRing (S' q)] [∀ q, Algebra k (S' q)] [∀ q, Algebra R (S' q)]
181	    [∀ q, IsScalarTower k R (S' q)] [∀ q, IsLocalization.Away (r q) (S' q)]
182	    (V : κ → κ → Type u) [∀ p q, CommRing (V p q)] [∀ p q, Algebra k (V p q)]
183	    [∀ p q, Algebra R (V p q)] [∀ p q, IsScalarTower k R (V p q)]
184	    [∀ p q, Algebra (S' p) (V p q)] [∀ p q, Algebra (S' q) (V p q)]
185	    [∀ p q, IsScalarTower k (S' p) (V p q)] [∀ p q, IsScalarTower k (S' q) (V p q)]
186	    [∀ p q, IsScalarTower R (S' p) (V p q)] [∀ p q, IsScalarTower R (S' q) (V p q)]
187	    [∀ p q, IsLocalization.Away (r p * r q) (V p q)]
188	    (hr : Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤)
189	    (E : ∀ q, CertifiedDivisorFamily C (S' q) π n)
190	    (hcompat : AwayCompatDivEq S' E V) :
191	    ∃ F₀ : DivFamZar C R π n,
192	      ∀ q, DivFamZar.mapAlg (S' q) n F₀ = (DivFam.mk (E q)).toZar := by
193	  classical
194	  haveI himm : ∀ q, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S' q)) := fun q =>
195	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (S' q) (r q)
196	  -- the glued local-equation system (S5, landed)
197	  set glue := awayGluedEquations r S' E V hr hcompat with hglue
198	  -- the glue is locally certified over the same cover
199	  have hloc : IsLocallyCertified C R π n glue := by
200	    obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin κ
201	    refine ⟨M, fun j => r (e.symm j), ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
202	    · have hrange : (Set.range fun j : Fin M => r (e.symm j)) = Set.range r :=
203	        e.symm.surjective.range_comp r
204	      rw [hrange, hr]
205	    · -- identify the carrier with the pinned localization and transport the witness
206	      set q := e.symm j with hq
207	      set B := Localization.Away (r q) with hB
208	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R B) :=
209	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R B (r q)
210	      letI : Algebra (S' q) B :=
211	        ((IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers (r q)) (S' q)
212	          B).toAlgHom.toRingHom).toAlgebra
213	      haveI : IsScalarTower R (S' q) B :=
214	        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x =>
215	          ((IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers (r q)) (S' q) B).commutes
216	            x).symm)
217	      haveI : IsScalarTower k (S' q) B :=
218	        isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := R)
219	      -- the chart restriction of the glue, transported along the identification
220	      have hdiv0 := (divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations r S' E V hr hcompat q
221	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
222	          (relCurveMap C R (S' q)) glue)).symm
223	      exact ⟨(E q).mapAlg B n,
224	        (E q).divEq_mapAlg_pullback B
225	          (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
226	            (relCurveMap C R B) glue) hdiv0⟩
227	  refine ⟨DivFamZar.mk glue hloc, fun q => ?_⟩
228	  -- the restriction law: the pulled glue is divisor-equal to the chart family
229	  exact DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
230	    (divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations r S' E V hr hcompat q _)
231	
232	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffPerPiece
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZar
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeCertZarPointwise
9	
10	/-!
11	# The widened `DivFamZar` (R2, human decision I-0492)
12	
13	The endpoint of the widening.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` is the locally-certified predicate
14	whose local certificates are carried by **arbitrary affine-open covers** rather than by basic
15	opens of a fixed pair of pinned `P¹` charts, and `DivFamZarAff` is its `DivEq` quotient —
16	the object the human decision of 2026-07-28 is about.
17	
18	## Why this is strictly weaker than the old predicate, which is the whole point
19	
20	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) turns every old cover datum into
21	a widened one, and `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean` migrates the CERTIFICATE on top of it, so
22	`isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified` holds: anything the old
23	predicate certified, the new one certifies.  The converse fails, and its failure is exactly
24	the content of R2 — a divisor straddling both pinned vertical fibres has no chart-typed
25	certificate (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 4 §4.3, on-stratum witness at every `g ≥ 2`)
26	but does admit an affine-open one, because `supp D` is finite over `R` and therefore lies in a
27	single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`).
28	
29	So `DivFamZarAff` is the value on which the divisor functor can be a Zariski sheaf over an
30	ARBITRARY field, with no `|P¹(k)| ≥ n + 2` hypothesis anywhere — the field-uniform fix.
31	
32	## The two relocated obligations (I-0492 clause 4)
33	
34	* **(i) fibrewise-finite support.** NOT a field of anything here.  It is not implied by
35	  what a `LocalEquations` carries (`d.eqn ≡ r` for a non-unit `r ∈ R` is germ-regular with a
36	  whole fibre curve in its support), so it must come from the seed's own degree data.  It
37	  enters as an explicit hypothesis at the point of use, never as carrier data: concretely as
38	  the `hfib` argument of `AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy`
39	  (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) and as `AffCoverData.SwallowedBy`
40	  (`DivisorFamilyAffSwallow.lean`).  Neither is a field of anything in this file.
41	* **(ii) what the fixed-pair confinement was silently supplying.** Discharged in
42	  `DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean` (`exists_mem_pieces` from the joint cover,
43	  `flat_sections_pieces` from the flat structure morphism) and in
44	  `DivisorFamilyAffPerPiece.lean` (the whole per-piece layer, from openness and affineness).
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff` — a certified family over a widened cover.
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertifiedAff` — the widened locally-certified predicate.
50	* `IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq` — it respects divisor equality.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff` — the widened functor value, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`
52	  and `picClass`.
53	
54	The comparison with the chart-typed predicate — `isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified`
55	and `DivFamZar.toAff` — is in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`, which imports this file.
56	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_exists_away` — the pointwise gate,
57	  one base point at a time, over the widened predicate.
58	-/
59	
60	set_option autoImplicit false
61	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
62	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
63	
64	universe u
65	
66	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
67	
68	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
69	
70	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
71	
72	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
73	  [Algebra k R]
74	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)
75	
76	/-! ## Certified families over a widened cover -/
77	
78	/-- **A certified divisor family of degree `n` over a widened cover**: a local-equation
79	system, an affine-open cover datum, an adaptation, and the certificate.  The cover is part of
80	the data (it is chosen per family), exactly as the old `adaptation` field bundled its own
81	`FinCoverData`. -/
82	structure CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff (n : ℕ) : Type u where
83	  /-- The local-equation system on the relative curve. -/
84	  eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations
85	  /-- The affine-open cover carrying the certificate. -/
86	  cover : AffCoverData C R
87	  /-- The adaptation of the system to that cover. -/
88	  adaptation : AffAdaptation cover eqns
89	  /-- The colength certificate of degree `n`. -/
90	  certified : adaptation.IsCertified n
91	
92	/-! ## The widened locally-certified predicate -/
93	
94	variable {C R}
95	
96	/-- **The widened locally-certified pin.**  Identical in shape to `IsLocallyCertified`
97	(`DivisorFamilyZar.lean`) — a span-`⊤` family `g : Fin m → R` with certified families over
98	the away localizations, divisor-equal to the pulled system — except that the local
99	certificates live over ARBITRARY AFFINE-OPEN covers.
100	
101	The base-side structure is untouched on purpose: R2 widens where the pieces live on the
102	CURVE, and changes nothing about the Zariski cover of the base. -/
103	def IsLocallyCertifiedAff (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
104	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
105	    ∀ i : Fin m,
106	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
107	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
108	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away (g i)) n,
109	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
110	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
111	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
112	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
113	
114	/-- **The widened pin respects divisor equality** — the local `DivEq`s transport through
115	`divEq_pullback`, verbatim as in the chart-typed case. -/
116	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
118	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d' := by
119	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
120	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
121	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
122	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
123	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
124	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
125	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
126	      h _ _)⟩
127	
128	/-! ## The comparison with the chart-typed predicate
129	
130	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) already migrates the COVER
131	sorry-free, and the adaptation's equations and `eqn_rel` transport with it because the pieces
132	are literally the same opens, only reindexed along `finSumFinEquiv`.
133	
134	The migration of the CERTIFICATE is landed too, in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`
135	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_toAff`, all seven clauses).  Clauses (c1) are `rfl` at the
136	relabelled index; the glued clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transport along `LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft`
137	in its `symm` direction, which evaluates cast-free, so the intertwining with
138	`deltaLeft`/`deltaRight` is componentwise and `Module.rankAtStalk` invariance is
139	`rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv`.  No clause changes, only the index does.
140	
141	A predecessor docstring here estimated that transport at about a hundred lines of equalizer
142	bookkeeping.  That was wrong by an order of magnitude and the reason generalises: arrange the
143	reindexed cover so its pieces are DEFINITIONALLY the original pieces at the relabelled index,
144	and the overlap data at `(i, j)` becomes `rfl`-equal to the original at `(e i, e j)`, because
145	reindexing acts diagonally on the pair index.  Then no intertwining lemma exists to prove. -/
146	
147	/-! ## The widened functor value -/
148	
149	variable (C R) (n : ℕ)
150	
151	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on widened locally-certified systems. -/
152	def divFamZarAffSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
153	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} where
154	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
155	  iseqv :=
156	    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
157	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
158	
159	/-- **The widened divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`** (R2, I-0492): locally
160	certified systems of degree `n` up to divisor equality, where "certified" is now witnessed by
161	arbitrary affine-open covers of the relative curve.
162	
163	This is the carrier that is field-uniform: no hypothesis on `|P¹(k)|` appears anywhere in its
164	definition or in the per-piece layer that produces it. -/
165	def DivFamZarAff : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n)
166	
167	namespace DivFamZarAff
168	
169	variable {C R n}
170	
171	/-- The class of a widened locally certified system. -/
172	def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) :
173	    DivFamZarAff C R n :=
174	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n) ⟨d, hd⟩
175	
176	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
177	    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₂} :
178	    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
179	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarAffSetoid C R n)
180	
181	/-- **The Picard class of a widened divisor class** `𝒪(D)`, well defined by
182	`picClass_eq_of_divEq`.  This is the Abel hook DAT-C consumes, unchanged by the widening. -/
183	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
184	  Quotient.lift
185	    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} =>
186	      d.1.picClass)
187	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F
188	
189	@[simp]
190	lemma picClass_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
191	    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) : picClass (mk d hd) = d.picClass :=
192	  rfl
193	
194	end DivFamZarAff
195	
196	/-! ## The pointwise gate over the widened predicate -/
197	
198	variable {C R n}
199	
200	/-- **The pointwise certificate gate, widened.** If over every prime of the base there is an
201	away localization carrying a widened certified family divisor-equal to the pulled system, the
202	system is widened-locally certified.  Same quasi-compactness step as
203	`isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away` (`DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean`): the good
204	elements' basic opens cover `Spec R`, so finitely many span the unit ideal.
205	
206	This is the shape the geometry produces — the support tube isolates pieces over a
207	neighbourhood of ONE base point, and every fibre analysis reads at a single prime. -/
208	theorem isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_exists_away
209	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
210	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
211	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
212	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
213	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away r) n,
214	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
215	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
216	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
217	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) :
218	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d := by
219	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hgood⟩ := exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime
220	    (fun r =>
221	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
222	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
223	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away r) n,
224	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
225	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
226	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
227	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) h
228	  exact ⟨m, g, hg, hgood⟩
229	
230	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffCert
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffZar
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffCompare
9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg
10	
11	/-!
12	# The widened divisor-functor map (R2, human decision I-0492)
13	
14	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` along an arbitrary test change `R → R'`, with the functor laws, the Abel
15	hook, and the Zariski separation keystone.  This is what makes the widened value a functor
16	VALUE rather than a bare type: before this file nothing could base-change a widened class.
17	
18	## Where the widening does and does not show
19	
20	Almost nowhere.  `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` widens where the pieces live on the CURVE and changes
21	nothing about the Zariski cover of the BASE, so the base-side machinery of
22	`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean` — the `Localization.Away` towers, `IsLocalization.map`,
23	`span_range_algebraMap_eq_top` — applies verbatim; the cover datum only appears inside the
24	opaque `mapAlg` of the local certified family.  Likewise
25	`Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback`, `divEq_pullback_id` and `divEq_pullback_pullback` are
26	stated for ARBITRARY scheme morphisms and know nothing about covers, so the functor laws are
27	the same three lines as in the chart-typed case.
28	
29	## The one honest cost of the widening: overlap affineness
30	
31	`AffCoverData` demands affineness of the pieces only (that is the R2 shape), so the certificate
32	transport takes an explicit `hinf` — the overlaps are affine.  A `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`
33	therefore cannot be base-changed without it, and rather than weaken the structure this file
34	carries `hinf` as a hypothesis on `mapAlg` at the family level.  It is not a hidden
35	assumption: it is visible in every signature below, as I-0492 clause 4 requires.  For a
36	relative curve over a proper `C` it is discharged by separatedness (`IsAffineOpen.inf`).
37	
38	## Main declarations
39	
40	* `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg` — base change of a widened certified family.
41	* `IsLocallyCertifiedAff.pullback` — certificate transport along an arbitrary test change.
42	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg`, with `mapAlg_mk`, `picClass_mapAlg`, `mapAlg_id`, `mapAlg_comp`.
43	* `DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq` — Zariski separation at the widened Zar level.
44	-/
45	
46	set_option autoImplicit false
47	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
49	
50	universe u
51	
52	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
53	open Opposite TensorProduct
54	
55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
56	
57	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
58	
59	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
60	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
61	
62	/-- **Overlap affineness of a widened cover** — the one datum the certificate transport needs
63	beyond `AffCoverData`'s own fields.  Named so that it can be threaded explicitly and read off
64	any signature; for a relative curve over a proper `C` it follows from separatedness. -/
65	def AffCoverData.HasAffineOverlaps (D : AffCoverData C R) : Prop :=
66	  ∀ i j : D.index, IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
67	
68	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
69	variable (n : ℕ)
70	
71	/-- **Base change of a widened certified family**: pulled equations, base-changed cover and
72	adaptation, transported certificate. -/
73	noncomputable def CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg (F : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C R n)

113	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra R A] [IsScalarTower k R A]

123	  have hregMid := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
124	    (relCurveMap C A B) hdiv

133	
134	The widened analogue of `IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`: a widened
135	locally certified system has regular pulled equations along an arbitrary test tower.
136	Regularity is germ-local on the curve, and the covering argument is on the BASE, so the proof
137	is the chart-typed one with `CertifiedDivisorFamily` replaced by
138	`CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`. -/

140	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
141	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
142	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R) n d)
143	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
144	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
145	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
146	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
147	  classical
148	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
149	  haveI himm : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
150	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
151	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>
152	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
153	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
154	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range
155	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by
156	    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
157	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
158	      ext x
159	      exact ⟨by rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
160	        by rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨j⟩, rfl⟩⟩
161	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
162	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover
163	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R'
164	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))
165	    (fun y' => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R'
166	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
167	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
168	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz
169	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
170	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) :=
171	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i.down)) (g i.down)
172	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i.down))
173	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
174	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i.down))
175	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
176	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R')
177	      (by
178	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
179	        use e
180	        simp)).toAlgebra
181	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
182	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
183	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
184	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
185	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
186	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i.down))
187	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
188	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
189	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i.down)),
190	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
191	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
192	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),
193	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
194	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])
195	  have hcomp₁ : relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
196	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
197	      ≫ relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
198	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
199	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := Localization.Away (g i.down))
200	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
201	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
202	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
203	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
204	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R')
205	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
206	  have step1 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_congr hcomp₂ d ζ
207	  have step2 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_comp hcomp₁ d
208	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
209	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) d) ζ
210	  have hfinal := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
211	    (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
212	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) hGdiv ζ
213	    (G.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
214	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
215	      G.certified.projective_colength ζ ζ
216	      ((G.eqns.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
217	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))).mem_opens ζ))
218	  exact ((step1.trans step2).symm ▸ hfinal)

221	
222	`IsProper C.hom` from here on: it is what makes `HasAffineOverlaps` free
223	(`hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper`), so no `hinf` appears in any statement below.  The DD-R lane

234	spans `⊤` and the certified part over each `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` is

237	`IsLocallyCertified.pullback` (`DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg.lean`): the proof is the same, with the
238	cover datum appearing only inside the opaque `mapAlg`. -/

240	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (hreg) :
241	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R') n
242	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg) := by
243	  classical
244	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
245	  have hloc' : IsLocallyCertifiedAff (C := C) (R := R) n d := ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩
246	  refine ⟨m, fun i => algebraMap R R' (g i), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
247	  · have hrange : (Set.range fun i : Fin m => algebraMap R R' (g i))
248	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
249	      ext x
250	      exact ⟨by rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
251	        by rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
252	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]

255	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
256	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
257	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) :=

259	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) (algebraMap R R' (g i))

261	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i))
262	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
263	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i))
264	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
265	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) (algebraMap R R')
266	      (by
267	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
268	        use e
269	        simp)).toAlgebra
270	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i))
271	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
272	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
273	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
274	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
275	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i))
276	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
277	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
278	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i)),
279	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
280	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i))
281	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))),
282	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
283	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))])
284	  -- witness transport along `R → Localization.Away (g i) → the pushed chart`
285	  have hW := G.divEq_mapAlg_pullback n (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
286	    (G.cover.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper)
287	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
288	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) hGdiv
289	  -- the composite collapse through the `R'`-side factorization
290	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
291	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
292	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
293	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R') (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
294	  have hstep := Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_pullback hcomp₂ d hreg
295	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
296	      (relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))

299	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))

304	
305	/-- **The widened divisor-functor map on locally certified classes** along an ARBITRARY test
306	change: pull back the representative (the widened mapAlg-hreg engine discharges regularity) and
307	transport the certificates.  Well defined by `divEq_pullback`.

309	With this, `DivFamZarAff` is a functor value: the field-uniform carrier of R2 base-changes
310	exactly as the chart-typed one did. -/
311	noncomputable def DivFamZarAff.mapAlg :
312	    DivFamZarAff C R n → DivFamZarAff C R' n :=
313	  Quotient.lift
314	    (fun dp : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} =>
315	      DivFamZarAff.mk (dp.1.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')
316	          (dp.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' n))
317	        (dp.2.pullback R' n _))
318	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
319	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') h _ _))

326	          (hd.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' n))

367	/-! ## Zariski separation at the widened Zar level -/

369	/-- **Zariski separation of the widened divisor functor**: two widened classes agreeing under
370	`mapAlg` on every member of a finite covering family of localizations agree.
371	
372	Certificates play no role in equality, so — exactly as for `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq` — this
373	reduces verbatim to the `DivEq`-level engine `divEq_of_divEq_pullback`, and the widening is
374	invisible.  Note this needs `[IsProper C.hom]` only because `mapAlg` does. -/
375	theorem DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq [IsProper C.hom] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R)
376	    (S : ι → Type u)
377	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
378	    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
379	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) {F G : DivFamZarAff C R n}
380	    (h : ∀ i, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n F = DivFamZarAff.mapAlg (S i) n G) :
381	    F = G := by
382	  haveI : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S i)) := fun i =>
383	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (S i) (g i)
384	  revert h
385	  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ F G fun d₁ d₂ h => ?_
386	  refine DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ?_
387	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback
388	    (fun i => relCurveMap C R (S i))
389	    (fun y => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R g S hg y)
390	    (fun i => d₁.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i) n)
391	    (fun i => d₂.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i) n)
392	    (fun i => ?_)

395	/-! ## Obligation I-0492 4(i) read on the FIBRE CURVE
396	
397	The widened assembler's fibrewise-regularity input (`hfib` of
398	`AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy`, `DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) is stated as a
399	tensor condition: `eqn j ⊗ 1` is a nonzerodivisor in `Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p)`.  Protection
400	I-0492 clause 4(i) says that datum must come from the seed's own degree data, and a tensor
401	product is not the shape any geometric argument produces.
402	
403	The section base change of this file's upstream turns it into the shape that IS produced:
404	`Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p) ≅ Γ(relCurve C κ(p), relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ pieces j)`, so `hfib` at `p` says
405	exactly that the **pulled equation is regular on the fibre curve over `κ(p)`** — a statement
406	about a section of a sheaf on a curve over a field, checkable germ by germ.
407	
408	This is a restatement, not a discharge: the obligation stays an obligation, as clause 4(i)
409	requires.  What changes is that it is now stated in the vocabulary the seed layer speaks.  -/

411	section Fibre
412	
413	variable {n}
414	
415	/-- **The fibrewise-regularity obligation, read on the fibre curve.**  `eqn j ⊗ 1` is a
416	nonzerodivisor in `Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p)` **iff** the compared equation is a nonzerodivisor in
417	the sections of the fibre curve over `κ(p)` on the preimage of the piece.
418	
419	Both directions are the same ring isomorphism, so this is an honest translation with no
420	hypothesis beyond affineness of the piece — which is a field of `AffCoverData`. -/
421	theorem AffAdaptation.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff {D : AffCoverData C R}

200	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) (hcompat : AwayCompatDivEq S E T)
201	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n)
202	    (hG : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat))
203	    (i : ι) :
204	    DivFam.mapAlg (S i) n (DivFam.mk G) = DivFam.mk (E i) := by
205	  rw [DivFam.mapAlg_mk]
206	  refine DivFam.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ?_
207	  exact Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq.trans
208	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (S i)) hG
209	      (G.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i)
210	        G.certified.projective_colength)
211	      (fun y z hz =>
212	        Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
213	          (relCurveMap C R (S i)) (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat) y z hz))
214	    (divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hcompat i _)
215	
216	/-- **Zariski gluing of the divisor functor, conditional form**
217	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): a family of divisor classes on a covering family of
218	localizations of `R`, compatible on the pairwise overlap carriers, is the family of
219	restrictions of a class over `R` — GIVEN a certified representative of the glued
220	system over `R` (the hypothesis `hcert`; see the module docstring for the open
221	certificate seam this isolates).  Uniqueness of the glued class is S4's
222	`DivFam.eq_of_away_eq`. -/
223	theorem DivFam.exists_glue_of_away_compat_of_certifiedRep
224	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) (F : ∀ i, DivFam C (S i) π n)
225	    (hcompat : ∀ i j, DivFam.mapAlg (T i j) n (F i) = DivFam.mapAlg (T i j) n (F j))
226	    (hcert : ∀ (E : ∀ i, CertifiedDivisorFamily C (S i) π n),
227	      (∀ i, DivFam.mk (E i) = F i) → ∀ hdiv : AwayCompatDivEq S E T,
228	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n,
229	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns (awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hdiv)) :
230	    ∃ F₀ : DivFam C R π n, ∀ i, DivFam.mapAlg (S i) n F₀ = F i := by
231	  classical
232	  -- representatives of the local classes
233	  have hrep : ∀ i, ∃ Ei : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (S i) π n, DivFam.mk Ei = F i :=
234	    fun i => Quotient.exists_rep (F i)
235	  choose E hE using hrep
236	  -- the representative-level compatibility
237	  have hdiv : AwayCompatDivEq S E T := by
238	    intro i j
239	    have h := hcompat i j
240	    rw [← hE i, ← hE j, DivFam.mapAlg_mk, DivFam.mapAlg_mk] at h
241	    exact DivFam.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp h
242	  -- the certified representative of the glued system, and its restrictions
243	  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := hcert E hE hdiv
244	  exact ⟨DivFam.mk G, fun i =>
245	    (DivFam.mapAlg_mk_eq_of_divEq_awayGluedEquations g S E T hg hdiv G hG i).trans
246	      (hE i)⟩
247	
248	end AlgebraicGeometry

9	/-!
10	# Zariski gluing of local-equation systems over an away cover (DD-2 stage S5)
11	
12	The divisor-assembly half of the divisor-functor Zariski gluing
13	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): for a span-⊤ family `g : ι → R` with localization
14	carriers `S i` (the S4 packaging), representatives `(E i)` of compatible divisor classes
15	over the `S i` glue at the `LocalEquations` level to a system on the relative curve
16	over `R`, whose pullback along each comparison `relCurveMap C R (S i)` is
17	divisor-equal to the local system.
18	
19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_relCurveMap_base_eq_pair` — the **pairwise point lift**: a
20	  point of `C_R` lifting to both `C_{S₁}` and `C_{S₂}` lifts to the overlap curve
21	  `C_T`, `IsLocalization.Away (g₁ * g₂) T` (the S4 point-lift pattern at the product).
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.awayGlueIndex`/`awayGlueLift` — the chosen chart index and
23	  preimage of a point of `C_R` (the S4 span-⊤ point lift, packaged by choice).
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AwayCompatDivEq` — the representative-level overlap
25	  compatibility: over each overlap carrier `T i j` the two pulled systems are
26	  divisor-equal.
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_res_awayTransport_eq_unit_mul` — **the pointwise cross
28	  unit**: near any point of an overlap of two transported members (possibly from
29	  different charts), the two transported equations differ by a unit — through the
30	  overlap curve `C_{T i j}`: the compatibility `DivEq` provides the unit upstairs,
31	  conjugated by the transition units of the two local systems, and the open immersion
32	  `relCurveMap C R (T i j)` descends it (the Kit's section-form unit descent).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.awayGluedEquations` — **the glued system**: at `y` the member is
34	  the image of the chosen chart's covering member and the equation is the immersion
35	  transport of the chart equation; `ratio_isUnit` upgrades the pointwise cross units to
36	  full overlap units by the Kit's unit-spreading engine (regularity gluing).
37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divEq_pullback_awayGluedEquations` — **restriction to the charts**:
38	  the pullback of the glued system along `relCurveMap C R (S i)` is divisor-equal to
39	  the `i`-th local system (the members and equations restrict back by construction —
40	  the immersion round trip).
41	
42	The class-level assembly (the conditional keystone) is
43	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZariskiGlueClass`.
44	-/

65	/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
66	private lemma res_res {X : Scheme.{u}} {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U)
67	    (s : Γ(X, U)) :
68	    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
69	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by

73	proof-irrelevant). -/
74	private lemma appLE_hom_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = f')
75	    {U : Y.Opens} {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
76	    f.appLE U W e = f'.appLE U W (h ▸ e) := by
77	  subst h; rfl

79	/-! ## The pairwise point lift -/
80	
81	section PairLift
82	
83	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
84	
85	/-- **The pairwise point lift** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): a point of the relative
86	curve `C_R` that lifts to the relative curves of two away localizations `S₁, S₂` lifts
87	to the relative curve of an overlap carrier `T`, `IsLocalization.Away (g₁ * g₂) T`.
88	The structure image avoids both `g₁` and `g₂` (it lies in both comap ranges), hence
89	avoids `g₁ * g₂`, and the whisker square is a pullback of topological images
90	(`Over.range_whiskerLeft` — the S4 point-lift pattern). -/
91	theorem exists_relCurveMap_base_eq_pair (g₁ g₂ : R) (S₁ S₂ T : Type u)
92	    [CommRing S₁] [CommRing S₂] [CommRing T]
93	    [Algebra k S₁] [Algebra k S₂] [Algebra k T]
94	    [Algebra R S₁] [Algebra R S₂] [Algebra R T]
95	    [IsScalarTower k R S₁] [IsScalarTower k R S₂] [IsScalarTower k R T]
96	    [IsLocalization.Away g₁ S₁] [IsLocalization.Away g₂ S₂]
97	    [IsLocalization.Away (g₁ * g₂) T]
98	    {y : relCurve C R} {z₁ : relCurve C S₁} (hz₁ : (relCurveMap C R S₁).base z₁ = y)
99	    {z₂ : relCurve C S₂} (hz₂ : (relCurveMap C R S₂).base z₂ = y) :
100	    ∃ z : relCurve C T, (relCurveMap C R T).base z = y := by
101	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (overSpecMap (k := k) R S₁).left := by
102	    rw [overSpecMap_left]
103	    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization g₁
104	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (overSpecMap (k := k) R S₂).left := by
105	    rw [overSpecMap_left]
106	    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization g₂
107	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (overSpecMap (k := k) R T).left := by
108	    rw [overSpecMap_left]
109	    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization (g₁ * g₂)
110	  -- the structure image of `y` lies in both comap ranges, hence avoids `g₁` and `g₂`
111	  have hmem₁ : (show PrimeSpectrum R from (snd C (overSpec k R)).left.base y)
112	      ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S₁)) := by
113	    have hy₁ : y ∈ Set.range ((C ◁ overSpecMap (k := k) R S₁).left).base := ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩
114	    rw [Over.range_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) R S₁)] at hy₁
115	    exact hy₁
116	  have hmem₂ : (show PrimeSpectrum R from (snd C (overSpec k R)).left.base y)
117	      ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S₂)) := by
118	    have hy₂ : y ∈ Set.range ((C ◁ overSpecMap (k := k) R S₂).left).base := ⟨z₂, hz₂⟩
119	    rw [Over.range_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) R S₂)] at hy₂
120	    exact hy₂
121	  rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := S₁) g₁] at hmem₁
122	  rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := S₂) g₂] at hmem₂
123	  -- hence it lies in the comap range of the overlap carrier
124	  have hmemT : (show PrimeSpectrum R from (snd C (overSpec k R)).left.base y)
125	      ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T)) := by
126	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := T) (g₁ * g₂),
127	      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul]
128	    exact ⟨hmem₁, hmem₂⟩
129	  change y ∈ Set.range ((C ◁ overSpecMap (k := k) R T).left).base
130	  rw [Over.range_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) R T)]
131	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmemT
132	  exact ⟨q, hq⟩
133	
134	end PairLift

139	
140	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
141	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
142	variable {ι : Type u} (g : ι → R) (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)]
143	  [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)] [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)]
144	  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]

146	/-- The chosen chart index of a point of the glued relative curve (the S4 span-⊤ point
147	lift, packaged by choice). -/
148	noncomputable def awayGlueIndex (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
149	    (y : relCurve C R) : ι :=
150	  (exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R g S hg y).choose
151	
152	/-- The chosen preimage of a point of the glued relative curve on its chart curve. -/
153	noncomputable def awayGlueLift (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
154	    (y : relCurve C R) : relCurve C (S (awayGlueIndex g S hg y)) :=
155	  (exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R g S hg y).choose_spec.choose
156	
157	@[simp]
158	lemma relCurveMap_base_awayGlueLift (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
159	    (y : relCurve C R) :
160	    (relCurveMap C R (S (awayGlueIndex g S hg y))).base (awayGlueLift g S hg y) = y :=
161	  (exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R g S hg y).choose_spec.choose_spec

163	variable [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S i))]
164	variable {n : ℕ} (E : ∀ i, CertifiedDivisorFamily C (S i) π n)
165	
166	/-- Germ regularity of the immersion transport of a chart equation: the germs of the
167	transported equation are nonzerodivisors at every point of the image member (the Kit's
168	germ transport at the chart system's regularity). -/
169	lemma germ_awayTransport_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i : ι) (x' : relCurve C (S i))
170	    (z : relCurve C R)
171	    (hz : z ∈ relCurveMap C R (S i) ''ᵁ (E i).eqns.cover.opens x') :
172	    ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
173	        (relCurveMap C R (S i) ''ᵁ (E i).eqns.cover.opens x') z hz).hom
174	        (((relCurveMap C R (S i)).appIso ((E i).eqns.cover.opens x')).inv.hom
175	          ((E i).eqns.eqn x'))
176	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk z) :=
177	  Scheme.Hom.germ_appIso_inv_mem_nonZeroDivisors (relCurveMap C R (S i))
178	    (fun z' hz' => (E i).eqns.regular x' z' hz') z hz
179	
180	section Overlap
181	
182	variable (T : ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra k (T i j)]
183	  [∀ i j, Algebra R (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k R (T i j)]
184	  [∀ i j, Algebra (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra (S j) (T i j)]
185	  [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S j) (T i j)]
186	  [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S j) (T i j)]
187	  [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (g i * g j) (T i j)]
188	
189	/-- **The representative-level overlap compatibility** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5):
190	over each overlap carrier `T i j` the two pulled systems are divisor-equal — the
191	`DivEq` unfolding of the class-level compatibility
192	`mapAlg (T i j) n (F i) = mapAlg (T i j) n (F j)` at chosen representatives. -/
193	def AwayCompatDivEq : Prop :=
194	  ∀ i j, Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
195	    ((E i).adaptation.pulledEquations (T i j) (E i).certified.projective_colength)
196	    ((E j).adaptation.pulledEquations (T i j) (E j).certified.projective_colength)
197	
198	include g in
199	/-- **The pointwise cross unit** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §5): near any point `z` of an
200	open `O` inside the overlap of two transported members — from charts `i` and `j` at
201	points `x'`, `y'` — the two transported equations differ by a unit.  Route: `z` lifts
202	to the overlap curve `C_{T i j}` (pairwise point lift); upstairs, the compatibility
203	`DivEq` provides a unit between the two pulled equations at the lift, conjugated into
204	the transported equations by the transition units of the two chart systems; the open

end Affine

/-! ## The comparison from the chart-typed vehicle

`DivFamZar.toAff` (`…AffCompare.lean`) sends a chart-typed class to a widened one at a single
affine test, and `DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom` (`…AffFace.lean`) makes that compatible with
restriction on the explicit face.  Together they lift the comparison to the *vehicles*, which is
what a consumer holding a section over a general test needs.

The direction is old → new and only old → new.  That is not a limitation of the construction: it
is the content of R2.  A widened certificate cover is an arbitrary family of affine opens, and by
`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2 / ADDENDUM 4 §4.3 there is a straddling divisor at every
genus `≥ 2` that no fixed pair of `P¹` charts can confine, so no map back can exist. -/

section Compare

variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]

variable (C π n) in
/-- **The comparison of vehicles**: componentwise `DivFamZar.toAff`, compatible under
restriction by `DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom`.

This is the statement that makes the widened vehicle usable by a consumer that already holds a
chart-typed section: it does not have to be re-derived over the widened cover, it transports. -/
def divFamZarToAffVehicle {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
    divFamZarAff C n T :=
  ⟨fun U => (s.1 U).toAff,
    fun U V h => by
      beta_reduce
      rw [← s.compat U V h, DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom]⟩

/-- The value of the vehicle comparison at an affine open is the comparison of the value. -/
@[simp]
lemma divFamZarToAffVehicle_val {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T)
    (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
    (divFamZarToAffVehicle C π n s).1 U = (s.1 U).toAff :=
  rfl

/-- **The comparison intertwines the two affine comparisons**: on an affine test, passing to the
widened vehicle and collapsing agrees with collapsing and passing to the widened value.

Stated because it is the coherence a consumer actually uses — it says the widened vehicle's
value at an affine test is the widened value of the chart-typed one, with no ambiguity about
which of the two routes was taken. -/
lemma divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_toAffVehicle (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R)) :
    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n R (divFamZarToAffVehicle C π n s)
      = (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R s).toAff := by
  rw [divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply,
    divFamZarToAffVehicle_val, DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom]

end Compare

end

10	# The widened carrier's EXPLICIT-MAP face: `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom`
11	
12	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` (`…AffMapAlg.lean`) base-changes the widened class along an algebra
13	**tower instance pack** `[Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']`.  That is the right form
14	whenever a tower is already in scope, and it is what the S5b Zariski keystones are stated at.
15	
16	It is **not** the form the divisor vehicle consumes.  `divFamZar`
17	(`DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean`) indexes its compatibility condition by the section-restriction
18	maps `Over.resAlgHom T h`, which are bare `AlgHom`s carrying no tower instance, so the vehicle
19	and hence `divFunctor` are stated entirely at `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom`.  Until the widened carrier
20	has that same face, a widened class exists only at an affine test and nothing carries it to a
21	general one — measured at HEAD: outside the `DivisorFamilyAff*` files the name `DivFamZarAff`
22	appeared nowhere in the tree.
23	
24	So this file is the missing half of the base-change layer, and it is deliberately a *verbatim*
25	transcription of the chart-typed one: same names modulo `Aff`, same statements, same proofs.
26	Nothing here is new mathematics — `mapAlgHom` is `mapAlg` at `RingHom.toAlgebra` of the map,
27	and the two functor laws come from `mapAlg_id` / `mapAlg_comp` at the induced towers.  The
28	value of writing it is that the *consumer* side becomes typeable at all.
29	
30	## Why `[IsProper C.hom]` appears here and not in the chart-typed file
31	
32	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` needs it (`…AffMapAlg.lean` §Transport): properness is what makes
33	`AffCoverData.HasAffineOverlaps` free, and the widened certificate transport needs overlap
34	affineness because an arbitrary affine open's overlaps are not affine by fiat the way basic
35	opens of a fixed affine chart were.  It is a hypothesis the DD-R lane carries everywhere, so
36	this costs no generality — but it is stated rather than hidden, since it is exactly one of the
37	things I-0492 clause 4(ii) warns the old typing was silently supplying.
38

41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` — the explicit-map face.
42	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id`, `mapAlgHom_comp` — the functor laws on that face.
43	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_congr`, `mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg` — the face-change bridge, so a statement
44	  proved at a tower can be consumed at a restriction map and conversely.

46	* `DivFamZarAff.congr` — transport along an isomorphism of test algebras.

1	/-

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffSwallow
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.PiLocalization
8	
9	/-!
10	# The glued clauses on a straddling cover: (c2)/(c3)/(c4) REDUCE to (c1)
11	
12	The corrected cert-collapse claim (roadmap `...certificate.cert-collapse`, as amended after
13	the I-0340 refutation), carried out on the widened cover.
14	
15	## What was refuted and what survives
16	
17	The refuted claim was that (c2)/(c3)/(c4) are FREE for a swallow-or-miss adaptation.  They are
18	not, and `DivisorFamilyAffCollapse.lean` kernel-checks why: `toOvlLeft i i = toOvlRight i i`
19	by `rfl`, so every diagonal component of `deltaLeft - deltaRight` vanishes for EVERY
20	adaptation, and the diagonal factor always survives in the cokernel.  Clause (c4) therefore
21	always implies flatness of the diagonal overlap colengths — no structural observation about
22	which pieces meet the support can remove that.
23	
24	What survives is the REDUCTION the amended node states: on a cover with a straddling piece,
25	(c2)/(c3)/(c4) follow from (c1)-projectivity alone.  This file proves it.
26	
27	## The mechanism, and it is sharper than the node's account
28	
29	With a straddling piece `j₀`, every OTHER piece misses the support, so
30	`subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint` kills every overlap colength that involves an index
31	`≠ j₀` — in particular every OFF-DIAGONAL one, since a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least
32	one entry `≠ j₀`.  Combined with the vanishing diagonal, `deltaLeft - deltaRight` is the ZERO
33	map (`deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy`).  Hence:
34	
35	* `gluedSubmodule = ⊤`, so `Glued ≃ chartProd` — (c2) becomes a statement about the product of
36	  the piece colengths, of which all but one are subsingleton;
37	* `chartProd ⧸ gluedSubmodule` is subsingleton, so (c3) is free — and this IS free, with no
38	  input, which is the one part of the original claim that was right;
39	* `range (deltaLeft - deltaRight) = ⊥`, so the (c4) cokernel is `ovlProd` itself, whose
40	  factors are the overlap colengths: all subsingleton except `ovlColength j₀ j₀`.  So (c4)
41	  reduces to flatness of THAT ONE module — exactly the residue the refutation predicted, now
42	  isolated to a single index instead of a whole cover.
43	
44	## Main declarations
45	
46	* `AffAdaptation.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy` — the difference arrow vanishes identically.
47	* `AffAdaptation.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy` — the equalizer is everything.
48	* `AffAdaptation.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy` — hence `Glued ≃ₗ chartProd`.
49	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c3), unconditionally free.
50	* `AffAdaptation.ovlColengthDiagEquiv` — the diagonal overlap colength IS the piece colength
51	  (the cert-collapse node's "one technical lemma still needed", in the diagonal case).
52	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c4) from (c1)-flatness alone.
53	* `AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1` — **the capstone**: the whole certificate
54	  from (c1) plus the rank datum.
55	
56	## The upshot for the roadmap
57	
58	`isCertified_of_swallowedBy` (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) takes FIVE glued hypotheses.
59	On a straddling cover none of them is needed: `isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1` takes (c1)
60	finiteness and projectivity, plus `hrank`, and produces all seven clauses.  `hrank` is the
61	honest content of "the divisor has degree `n`" and cannot come from anywhere else.
62	
63	That is the corrected cert-collapse claim, discharged.  Note what it does NOT do: it does not
64	contradict the I-0340 refutation.  (c4) still *implies* flatness of the diagonal overlap
65	colengths — the refutation is a theorem.  What the straddling shape adds is that this
66	implication is now harmless, because on the diagonal that flatness IS (c1)-flatness, which the
67	fibrewise input already supplies.  The refutation said "(c4) is not free"; it is still not
68	free, it is just no longer an extra assumption.
69	-/
70	
71	set_option autoImplicit false
72	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
73	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
74	/- The three `simpa using congrFun …` steps below genuinely need `simpa`: the linter's
75	suggested `simp using` is not a tactic, and plain `exact` fails because the coerced presheaf
76	map has to be normalized before the two sides match. -/
77	set_option linter.unnecessarySimpa false
78	
79	universe u
80	
81	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
82	
83	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
84	
85	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
86	
87	namespace AffAdaptation
88	
89	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
90	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
91	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
92	variable (A : AffAdaptation D d)
93	
94	/-! ## Every overlap colength off the straddling diagonal vanishes -/
95	
96	/-- **An overlap involving a missing piece has vanishing colength.**  `SwallowedBy` says every
97	piece other than `j₀` is disjoint from the support, and an overlap is contained in each of its
98	two pieces, so it too misses the support. -/
99	lemma subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy {j₀ : D.index}
100	    (hmiss : ∀ j : D.index, j ≠ j₀ →
101	      Disjoint d.supportLocus (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
102	    (i j : D.index) (h : i ≠ j₀ ∨ j ≠ j₀) :
103	    Subsingleton (A.ovlColength i j) := by
104	  refine A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint i j fun z hz hsupp => ?_
105	  rcases h with hi | hj
106	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss i hi)) hsupp hz.1
107	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss j hj)) hsupp hz.2
108	
109	/-- **The difference arrow is identically zero on a straddling cover.**  On the diagonal it
110	vanishes for every adaptation whatsoever (`deltaSub_apply_diag`, the I-0340 fact); off the
111	diagonal the target is subsingleton, because a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least one
112	entry different from the straddling index. -/
113	theorem deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
114	    A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight = 0 := by
115	  obtain ⟨j₀, _, hmiss⟩ := h
116	  refine LinearMap.ext fun s => funext fun p => ?_
117	  by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2
118	  · -- diagonal: zero for every adaptation, by proof irrelevance on `inf_le_left/right`
119	    obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := p
120	    cases hp
121	    exact A.deltaSub_apply_diag s i
122	  · -- off-diagonal: at least one index misses the support, so the target is trivial
123	    haveI : Subsingleton (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) := by
124	      by_cases h1 : p.1 = j₀
125	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2
126	          (Or.inr fun h2 => hp (h1.trans h2.symm))
127	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2 (Or.inl h1)
128	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
129	
130	/-! ## The consequences for (c2)/(c3)/(c4) -/
131	
132	/-- **The equalizer is everything**: with the difference arrow zero, every section glues. -/
133	theorem gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
134	    A.gluedSubmodule = ⊤ := by
135	  rw [gluedSubmodule, A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]
136	  exact LinearMap.ker_zero
137	
138	/-- **Hence the glued module is the whole product of piece colengths.**  This is what makes
139	(c2) a statement about the piece colengths — of which, on a straddling cover, all but the
140	swallowing one are subsingleton. -/
141	noncomputable def gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
142	    A.Glued ≃ₗ[R] A.chartProd :=
143	  (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h)).trans
144	    Submodule.topEquiv
145	
146	/-- **Clause (c3) is free on a straddling cover** — no fibrewise input, no Noetherian
147	hypothesis, nothing.  The inclusion `W(d) ↪ ∏ colength` is onto, so its cokernel is trivial.
148	This is the one part of this leaf's refuted original claim that was correct. -/
149	theorem flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
150	    Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
151	  haveI : Subsingleton (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
152	    rw [A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h]; infer_instance
153	  haveI : Module.Free R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) :=
154	    Module.Free.of_subsingleton R _
155	  exact Module.Flat.of_free
156	
157	/-- **Clause (c2)-finiteness reduces to the piece colengths.** -/
158	theorem finite_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
159	    (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) :
160	    Module.Finite R A.Glued := by
161	  haveI := hfin
162	  haveI : Module.Finite R A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
163	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm
164	
165	/-- **Clause (c2)-projectivity reduces to the piece colengths.**  The index is a `Fin`, so the
166	product is the direct sum and `Module.Projective.directSum` applies. -/
167	theorem projective_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
168	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
169	    Module.Projective R A.Glued := by
170	  haveI := hproj
171	  haveI : Module.Projective R A.chartProd :=
172	    Module.Projective.of_equiv
173	      (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R D.index A.colength)
174	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm
175	
176	/-! ### The diagonal overlap IS the piece colength
177	
178	The identification the cert-collapse node calls "the one technical lemma still needed", in the
179	only case the straddling shape leaves: the diagonal.  It is easier there than in general
180	(`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` needs no unit argument, only `inf_idem`) but it is NOT
181	definitional — `Γ(pieces i ⊓ pieces i)` and `Γ(pieces i)` are different types, which is the
182	`inf`-bookkeeping hazard the node flags.  So it goes through a genuine algebra equivalence. -/
183	
184	/-- The opens-level idempotence, named so the transports below can rewrite with it. -/
185	lemma pieces_inf_self (i : D.index) : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i = D.pieces i := inf_idem _
186	
187	/-- **The diagonal overlap colength is the piece colength.**  Restriction along
188	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` is an algebra isomorphism carrying the overlap ideal — whose
189	two generators coincide there — onto `span {eqn i}`. -/
190	noncomputable def sectionsInfSelfEquiv (i : D.index) :
191	    Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i) ≃ₐ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i) where
192	  toFun := relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i).symm)
193	  invFun := relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i))
194	  left_inv := fun x => by
195	    rw [relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
196	      ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
197	    simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
198	      (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
199	        (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
200	  right_inv := fun x => by
201	    rw [relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
202	      ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
203	    simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
204	      (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
205	        (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
206	  map_mul' := map_mul _
207	  map_add' := map_add _
208	  commutes' := AlgHom.commutes _
209	
210	@[simp]
211	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_apply (i : D.index)
212	    (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i)) :
213	    sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i x
214	      = relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i).symm) x := rfl
215	
216	/-- **Restricting to the diagonal overlap and coming back is the identity.**  Stated as a
217	`simp` lemma because the two coercions (`AlgEquiv` vs the `RingHom` that `Ideal.map` takes)
218	are not syntactically equal, so `rw` cannot use the unstated form. -/
219	@[simp]
220	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_relResAlgHom (i : D.index)
221	    (h : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ D.pieces i) (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
222	    sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i (relResAlgHom C R h x) = x := by
223	  rw [sectionsInfSelfEquiv_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply,
224	    ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
225	  simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
226	    (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
227	      (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
228	
229	/-- The same identity in the `RingHom`-coerced spelling that `Ideal.map` produces.  Both
230	spellings are needed: `Ideal.map` takes the ring-hom coercion of the equivalence, and `rw`
231	does not see through the difference. -/
232	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_ringHom_relResAlgHom (i : D.index)
233	    (h : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ D.pieces i) (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
234	    ((sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i :
235	        Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i) →+* Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)))
236	      (relResAlgHom C R h x) = x :=
237	  sectionsInfSelfEquiv_relResAlgHom i h x
238	
239	/-- **The diagonal overlap colength is the piece colength.**  The overlap ideal at `(i, i)` is
240	generated by the two restrictions of `eqn i` along `inf_le_left` and `inf_le_right` — which at
241	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i` are the same proof of the same inequality, so the ideal is the span of a
242	single element, and `sectionsInfSelfEquiv` carries it to `span {eqn i}`. -/
243	noncomputable def ovlColengthDiagEquiv (i : D.index) :
244	    A.ovlColength i i ≃ₐ[R] A.colength i :=
245	  Ideal.quotientEquivAlg (A.ovlIdeal i i) (Ideal.span {A.eqn i})
246	    (sectionsInfSelfEquiv i)
247	    (by
248	      rw [AffAdaptation.ovlIdeal, Ideal.map_span]
249	      refine congrArg (Ideal.span) ?_
250	      simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
251	      rw [sectionsInfSelfEquiv_ringHom_relResAlgHom i inf_le_left (A.eqn i)]
252	      exact (Set.pair_eq_singleton (A.eqn i)).symm)
253	
254	/-- Hence flatness of the piece colengths gives flatness of the diagonal overlaps. -/
255	theorem flat_ovlColength_diag_of_flat_colength (i : D.index)
256	    [Module.Flat R (A.colength i)] :
257	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i i) :=
258	  Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (A.ovlColengthDiagEquiv i).toLinearEquiv
259	
260	/-- **Clause (c4) reduces to flatness of the piece colengths alone.**  The difference arrow is
261	zero, so its cokernel is `ovlProd` itself; every off-`j₀` factor is subsingleton, and the
262	surviving factor `ovlColength j₀ j₀` is the diagonal overlap of the straddling piece, whose
263	flatness is what the refutation identified as unavoidable.  It is supplied here as `hdiag`,
264	one module rather than a whole cover — which is precisely the reduction the amended
265	cert-collapse node claims. -/
266	theorem flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy' (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
267	    (hdiag : ∀ i j : D.index, Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i j)) :
268	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) := by
269	  haveI : ∀ p : D.index × D.index, Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) :=
270	    fun p => hdiag p.1 p.2
271	  haveI : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd := Module.Flat.pi_of_finite
272	  have hrange : LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) = ⊥ := by
273	    rw [A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]; exact LinearMap.range_zero
274	  rw [hrange]
275	  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl)
276	
277	/-- **Every overlap colength is flat, from (c1)-flatness alone.**  Two cases, exhausting the
278	pairs: off the diagonal at least one index misses the support (straddling), so the overlap
279	colength is subsingleton hence free; on the diagonal it IS the piece colength, by
280	`ovlColengthDiagEquiv`.  This removes the last non-(c1) input from clause (c4). -/
281	theorem flat_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
282	    (hflat : ∀ j, Module.Flat R (A.colength j)) (i j : D.index) :

---
name: diff-api-by-face-not-name
description: A replacement type's base-change layer can be complete at every NAME and still unusable, because the vehicle/functor layer is typed against the OTHER face (explicit-map vs instance-tower).
metadata:
  type: project
---

AJCR run 0070 s0010 (`ajcr-cert-r2`), 2026-07-28, measured at HEAD.

A carrier that base-changes usually has **two faces of the same operation**:

* an **instance-parameterized** face `mapAlg`, taking `[Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']`;
* an **explicit-map** face `mapAlgHom`, taking a bare `(φ : A →ₐ[k] A')`.

They are trivially interderivable (`mapAlgHom` is `mapAlg` at `RingHom.toAlgebra` of the map;
the bridge back is one `Algebra.algebra_ext`), so a lane that builds one believes it has built
base change.

**Why it bites:** the functor/vehicle layer *cannot* use the instance face. A Zariski vehicle
indexes its compatibility condition by section-restriction maps (`Over.resAlgHom`), which are
bare `AlgHom`s carrying no tower instance. So AJCR's `divFamZar` and `divFunctor` are stated
entirely at `mapAlgHom`. Until the new carrier has that face it has no vehicle, no functor, and
no consumer can be stated against it — the value exists only at an affine test.

**What it cost:** `DivFamZarAff` (the R2 widened carrier, protection I-0492) had `mapAlg`,
`mapAlg_id`, `mapAlg_comp`, `picClass_mapAlg`, `eq_of_away_eq` — and no `mapAlgHom`. Four
sessions closed reporting "the widened value is a functor value": true of `mapAlg`, the wrong
face.

**The check, one line:** grep the NEW type's name *outside the files that define it*. Zero hits
means the replacement is an island regardless of how complete its own layer looks. Then ask
which face the vehicle/functor is stated at, before pricing anything.

Sharper edge on [[new-type-needs-its-old-api]]: that one says diff the API; this says a
**name**-level diff reads as complete when one face is missing, because the two faces live
under different names and only one is absent. Cf. [[docstring-declaration-lists-unchecked]] for
the same "green build cannot see an absence" failure mode.

Landed fix: `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFace.lean`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffVehicle.lean`
(ed13f29a1, 2a1e05623, a5c5ca3e9). Workspace record: inbox I-0617.

337	    refine ⟨(relCurveMap C R R').unitsAppLE
338	      (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y'))
339	      ((D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y') hle u, ?_⟩
340	    -- LHS: the restricted pulled equation collapses to `appLE` of the piece equation
341	    have hres₁ : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
342	        (D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y' ≤
343	          (D.baseChange R').pieces j)).op).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) =
344	        ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (D.pieces j)
345	          ((D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y')
346	          hle₁).hom (A.eqn j) := by
347	      rw [show A.pulledEqn R' j = ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (D.pieces j)
348	          ((D.baseChange R').pieces j) le_rfl).hom (A.eqn j) from rfl,
349	        ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
350	    -- RHS: the restricted pulled system equation collapses to `appLE` of `d`'s equation
351	    have hres₂ : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
352	        (D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y' ≤
353	          (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y')).op).hom
354	        ((A.pulledEquations R' hproj).eqn y') =
355	        ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y'))
356	          ((D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y')
357	          hle₂).hom (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y')) :=
358	      Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn_res (relCurveMap C R R') d y' _
359	    -- the pre-restriction collapse on both sides
360	    have e₁ := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (relCurveMap C R R') hle
361	      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : D.pieces j ⊓
362	        d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y') ≤ D.pieces j)).op)).hom (A.eqn j))
363	    have e₂ := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (relCurveMap C R R') hle
364	      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : D.pieces j ⊓
365	        d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y') ≤
366	        d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y'))).op)).hom
367	      (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y')))
368	    -- transport the unit relation through `appLE`
369	    have key := congrArg ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE
370	      (D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y'))
371	      ((D.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓ (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y')
372	      hle).hom hu
373	    rw [map_mul] at key
374	    exact hres₁.trans (e₁.symm.trans (key.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) rfl
375	      (e₂.trans hres₂.symm))))

57	namespace LocalEquations
